clips.title: The story
paras: The Glyphic Scroll is a summons delivered to newly raised Forsaken magi in Deathknell. Bearing the seal of Isabella, the local arcane trainer, it calls fledgling spellcasters to the desecrated church to refine their craft in undeath.

When a freshly awakened Forsaken mage returns from culling mindless Scourge in the graveyard of Deathknell, this sealed missive awaits them. Written under the mark of Isabella, the settlement's resident mage trainer, the scroll calls the recipient into the ruined parish sanctuary. For newly risen magi, it serves as an initial orientation into the discipline of the arcane under the Forsaken banner—reminding them that while death may have unburdened them of mortal weakness, the corrupting temptations of magical power remain as persistent as ever.
